usage: valvur findings [-h] [--fingerprint FINGERPRINT] [--group GROUP] [--rule RULE]
                       [--path PREFIX] [--status {new,persisting,regressed}] [--limit LIMIT]
                       [--include-suppressed] [--inventory]
                       [path]

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --fingerprint FINGERPRINT
                        One finding, in full
  --group GROUP         A group's id, from findings.json
  --rule RULE
  --path PREFIX         Findings under this path, on whole segments
  --status {new,persisting,regressed}
  --limit LIMIT
  --include-suppressed
  --inventory           Also list the sinks named for review, which are not findings by themselves
